items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: Let's see, Sonny Stitt, Lucky Thompson, Charlie Parker, I can't think of the other --

ctx.x: See, that was a package. Now, they might have paid $4,000 for that package, see. It was a package deal. Benny Carter's band, and he had J.J. on the trombone at the time, see. And what happened, J.J. had been laughing at this girl, or something back there, and one of the boys back there, one of the white fellows, hit him. And Benny Carter pulled his band out. Well, they didn't have a band to play. They went and got George Hudson, and George Hudson agreed to go in there and play. All the other bands wouldn't go…

And later on, Billy Eckstine came in, and he came -- he brought Sarah Vaughan back with him. That was the band with all the jazz stars. (Unintelligible). You know about that. We talked about that. Let's see, Sonny Stitt, Lucky Thompson, Charlie Parker, I can't think of the other --
